## Completeness and clarity

- [x] CHK001 Are the active version and legacy-rejection boundary explicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are all four modes and fresh/retained deployment units defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Are fixed protocol settings distinguished from evidence-dependent N/windows? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004–FR-005]
- [x] CHK004 Are all S1–S4/provider settings and all-cloud/replacement exceptions bounded? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006–FR-007]
- [x] CHK005 Are configuration, scheduled row, observation, attempt and deployment identities distinct? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002/FR-008/FR-010]

## Evidence and failure semantics

- [x] CHK006 Are source/resolved/row/Git identities and dirty-state hashing specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK007 Are artifact ownership, closed state, path safety and integrity evidence defined by mode? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK008 Are actual timing, clock mapping and gaps separate from declared duration? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK009 Are missing/reset diagnostic values and static observed metadata distinguished from intent? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK010 Are execution/data/comparison/cleanup and primary/retrieval/cleanup failures independent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012/FR-017]
- [x] CHK011 Are immutable collision and partial-initialization requirements measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011–FR-012/SC-003]

## Safety and ownership

- [x] CHK012 Are management/private paths and authenticated references specified without secret export? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018/FR-020]
- [x] CHK013 Are complete-lifetime reservation and pre-create provider expiry declarations distinct from admission? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009/FR-019]
- [x] CHK014 Are unresolved later-feature policies assigned owners without changing fixed source rules? [Dependency, Spec §FR-015/FR-019/Assumptions]
- [x] CHK015 Are downstream runtime engines, paid work and historical file edits excluded explicitly? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024/Assumptions]
- [x] CHK016 Are schema/runtime/native fixture coverage and no-external-I/O acceptance criteria objective? [Measurability, Spec §FR-021–FR-023/SC-001–SC-005]
